pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with predominantly sharp edge gradients and high angularity. Spatial area is significantly larger on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the proximal limbs and upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of thin, light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes typically connect three to four patch vertices, with relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line, representing the mane contour against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct discontinuity in the mane pixel density is visible at the transition point between the cervical and thoracic vertebrae.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, avian-shaped silhouette is perched on the dorsal midline above the sacral region, exhibiting distinct contrast from the surrounding pelage.
